value.deck: A test version of GitHub's private business software is out now, offering companies an early look at upcoming AI and security tools.
shortVersion: Many large organizations run software on their own private computers instead of using standard websites over the internet. GitHub has launched a preliminary test version of its software, called Enterprise Server 3.22, for these private corporate systems.

This test version lets technology teams try out new features before the official release. It brings upcoming artificial intelligence tools through Copilot and offers stronger security protections for private work environments.
Company managers can test this preview today to plan their future technology upgrades. Trying it early ensures that their systems will run smoothly when the final version arrives.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub released an early test version of its private software so business teams can try upcoming AI and security tools.

keyTerms.meaning: A nearly finished version of software released for final testing before the official public launch.
Running software programs on a company's own private computers rather than on a public cloud service.
An artificial intelligence assistant designed to help workers write and check computer code.

value.whyItMatters: It lets businesses safely prepare for new artificial intelligence and security features so their daily work remains smooth and safe.
watchNext: Watch for feedback from company technology teams as they test the new software version.
Look out for the official launch date of GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 after testing finishes.
